summary: Example: giving a_group ansible_group_priority 10 makes its testvar win over b_group's. ansible_group_priority can only be set in an inventory source, not group_vars.
questions: Can I set ansible_group_priority in group_vars?

answer_card.title: Use ansible_group_priority
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
a_group:
  vars:
    testvar: a
    ansible_group_priority: 10
b_group:
  vars:
    testvar: b
```
Result: `testvar == a` (it would be `b` with equal priority). Set `ansible_group_priority` only in an inventory source, not in `group_vars/`.
